value.quotedAs: Bank receipt about the transfer of the application fee

evidence.quote: The following documents need to be submitted during the application procedure by all applicants through our online application platform - that you can reach here:

If already graduated: certificate of education (school leaving qualification such as high school diploma, document of graduation or any equivalent; university degree certificate or any equivalent; all in English / translated);
Students in their final year of education: transcripts (end of year reports) of the last 2-3 academic years, plus predicted grades / expected graduation certificate.
Certificate or proof of citizenship and/or permanent residence (e.g. passport)
Short Resume/CV (personal details, educational background, work experience, language skills, additional skills)
Medical Certificate - please see a template here
Bank receipt about the transfer of the application fee of 150 USD (non-refundable) - bank details are available here

notes: Tuition is quoted in USD, not EUR or HUF; the page states 'The tuition fee for this program is 7,000 USD/Year'. Statutory tuition fee page (https://www.edu.unideb.hu/p/tuition-fee-application-entrance-fee) lists 'Biochemical Engineering *' under '8 semesters 7,500 USD/year', but this conflicts with the programme page's '3.5-year program consisting of 7 academic semesters' and '7,000 USD / year'. The programme page figure is prioritised. The entrance exam in mathematics and either chemistry or biology is a formal requirement but is a manual check because it requires exam scheduling. The language proficiency certificate requirement is explicitly stated for all applicants and has B2 level, TOEFL, IELTS details.

note.fr: Vérifier les conditions d'admission : certificat de fin d'études secondaires et réussite aux examens d'entrée en mathématiques et en chimie ou biologie.
note.en: Check admission conditions: high school certificate and passing entrance exams in Mathematics and either Chemistry or Biology.

evidence.quote: Is there an entrance exam for Biochemical Engineering, Bsc? Yes, admission is based on a high school certificate and online entrance exams in mathematics and Chemistry or Biology.
